scripts.ledger:snapshot: node -e "const l=require('./lib/pass-ledger.js'),fs=require('fs');const vis=l.ledgersReadable();if(!vis.tasks||!vis.mem){console.error('ledger docs unreadable at run root - refusing to stamp a snapshot from invisible bytes');process.exit(1)}const items=l.openItems();const s={schema:1,note:'Machine-visible open-item baseline for labs/TASKS.md + labs/MEM.md (pass-ledger lib/pass-ledger.js). ANY change to the census must update this file in the SAME commit as the ledger edit - a conscious act, never silent drift. Regenerate: npm run ledger:snapshot',stamped:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),count:items.length,items:items.map((i)=>({id:i.id,marker:i.marker,source:i.source,at:i.at}))};fs.writeFileSync('labs/open-items.snapshot.json',JSON.stringify(s,null,2)+'\n');console.log('snapshot stamped:',s.count,'open items')"
scripts.lint:web: eslint web/dashboard/src web/dashboard/test web/dashboard/functions web/relay/src web/relay/functions
scripts.lint:docs: node scripts/check-docs-style.js && node scripts/check-docs-links.js && node scripts/check-docs-frontmatter.js && node scripts/check-language.js && node scripts/check-docs-truthfulness.js
scripts.build:home: cd web/home && node scripts/gen-stats.mjs && node scripts/parse-changelog.mjs && npx prestruct build
scripts.check: for f in lib/*.js bin/*.js test/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'syntax OK'
scripts.check:battery: npm run test && npm run test:crashtest && npm run lint:claims && npm run lint:docs
